long_description:
Come enjoy a playful hour of family yoga right here in East Falls! Designed for children ages 3–9 and a parent or caregiver, this monthly workshop offers a welcoming, active space to breathe, move, stretch, play, and connect. Together, we will experience a dynamic yoga adventure inspired by the parks and landmarks of Philadelphia, practicing accessible postures, fun partner stretches, and calming mindfulness techniques. It is a fantastic weekend activity for families across the Roxborough, Manayunk, and Northwest Philly communities looking to move together and meet other local families. We can’t wait to welcome you to our studio in East Falls. 

Also check out other Health & Wellness events in Philadelphia, Workshops in Philadelphia, Trips & Adventurous Activities in Philadelphia.
